note: What a client sends as it locks its view to a unit or releases it. The header names no object: it carries zero.

revisions.note: A client sends it at once on each CameraLockSet, with state as that message carried it, all eight bits included.

bits.name: locked
bits.note: Set while the view follows a unit.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: As CameraLockSet carried them; zero where a server writes zero.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the client locking. Zero is a client id like any other rather than an absence.
